sections.label: Collection
sections.description: The Battery Included collection this environment's search, suggestions, recommendations and listings read from. Battery Included provides its name and API key.

fields.name: collection
fields.label: Collection
fields.description: The collection's name as Battery Included set it up. Every request names it.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: API key
fields.description: Sent with every request. Without it Battery Included refuses search, listings and recommendations.

sections.label: Listings
sections.description: How listings sort and which Battery Included fields they filter by. The defaults fit Battery Included's Shopware export; change them only for another index.

fields.name: sortings
fields.label: Sortings
fields.description: The sort options listings offer, in this order, as a JSON list. Each entry has a key (what the storefront sends), a label, and, for anything but relevance, a Battery Included field and an order, asc or desc. Replaces the defaults: relevance, price low to high and high to low, top sellers and newest.

fields.name: swatchFacets
fields.label: Swatch filters
fields.description: Fields whose filter values are shown as swatches, as a JSON list of field names, e.g. ["_product_i18n.properties.Farbe"]. A filter whose values already carry a colour or image from Battery Included is shown as swatches without being listed.

fields.name: fields
fields.label: Filter fields
fields.description: The fields category and product-stream listings filter by, as a JSON object with categoryId (default _product_i18n.categoryTree.id) and streamId (default _product.streamIds).

sections.label: Address
sections.description: Only needed when Battery Included gives you an address other than its default.

fields.name: baseURL
fields.label: API address
fields.description: Leave empty to use https://api.batteryincluded.io. The connection test always checks that default address.
